name: Cuscapi Berhad
overview: 2026年，Cuscapi Berhad 未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项。公司的主要公告集中在拟议股本削减（最多1.9亿令吉）及设立最多15%已发行股份的员工股份发行计划（SIS），以及多项重大诉讼和公司治理变动。最新一季（2026年6月30日）营收为755万令吉，同比增3.1%；净利润78.5万令吉，同比增149.9%。
overview_en: In 2026, Cuscapi Berhad did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or contract wins for its business segments. The company's key announcements focused on a proposed share capital reduction of up to RM190 million and the establishment of a share issuance scheme (SIS) of up to 15% of issued shares, along with material litigation and corporate governance changes. Latest quarter (30 June 2026) revenue was RM7.55 million, up 3.1% year-on-year;
